name: switch-3-to-7
reply:
What I saw
- ATT 4-3-3 shape facing a DEF 4-2-3-1 block in the middle third.
- The ball is circulating in the build-up zone on our left side.

On the board
- We highlighted a switch of play from our left-sided center-back (#3 LB / #4 CB) across to our right winger (#7 RW).
- Added a progression passing sequence from home-3-4 through home-6-5 to home-7-8.

Coaching points
- Scan early: before receiving, check the shoulder to see if the weak-side winger is isolated in space.
- Play away from pressure: circulate quickly to switch the point of attack when the opponent shifts heavy to one side.
- Weight of pass: use a driven aerial or flat diagonal pass so the winger can attack the space immediately.
